verdict.rationale: Storing passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence only shows Ente Auth adding and importing TOTP/HOTP secrets. The one passkey mention (ente-auth-docs-14) refers to passkeys as a way to secure the user's own Ente account, not to the app storing passkeys or signing users into third-party websites, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes
